title: The conormal integration factor equals the normalized normal-section orientation
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], a normalized etale compact-support datum N, a separated finite-type k-scheme B with structure map aB, and a smooth separated quasi-compact pure-dimension-d pair X=(g:V->B,s) with closed section [def-pur-section-restriction-data]. Let pi_N:N_s V->B be its actual normal projection and z its zero section. For any normalized ordinary finite Tate transport t [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], the isomorphism normalIntegration(P,N,aB,X) of [def-pur-normal-section-integration-data] equals normalComparison followed by the etale/pro-etale comparison pullback of chartSectionOrientation(P,d,pi_N,aB,z,t) [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data]. Thus the conormal-model inverse integration adjunct agrees with the specified orientation of the normal projection, after zero restriction. There is no DNC-specialization delta, diagonal exchange alpha or diagonal assembly in this statement. Rank zero and empty schemes are included.

proof.text: Take F=I_s/I_s^2 and use the inverse of the homogeneous Rees and symmetric conormal comparison as e:Spec Sym F~N_s V. The projection and zero-section equations in normalIntegration give precisely the hypotheses of normalModelSectionOrientation.

source.place: Step 4, vector presentation of the normal bundle

proof.text: Choose gamma to be the integration adjunction transpose precomposed with inverse canonical Tate pullback along the bundle projection. bundleAdjoint_isIso makes it an isomorphism. Its hom satisfies the adjunction equation by construction, so normalModelSectionOrientation identifies chartSectionOrientation with etale locality, pullback of chartDualizingUnit followed by gamma inverse, and Tate restriction.

Expand gamma and bundleSectionAdjoint. Coherence of canonical Tate pullback along pi z=identity identifies its two coefficient comparisons with the section compositor. Functoriality, inverse equations and the coefficient-unit comparison cancel to give bundleOrientation. Apply comparison-site pullback and precompose normalComparison to obtain the formula. The normalized pure-root maps are independent of the presentation t by their normalization; empty tensors and the identity compositor cover rank zero, and uniqueness on the empty site covers empty schemes.

theorem normalIntegration_eq_sectionOrientation (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {d : ℕ}
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [IsSeparated aB]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB] (X : Pair B d)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates) :
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj X.g X.s) :=
      (normalPair P aB X).smooth
    letI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj X.g X.s)
    letI : IsSeparated (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj X.g X.s) :=
      (normalPair P aB X).separated
    letI := Dnc.normalQuasiCompact d X.g X.s X.section_eq
    normalIntegration P N aB X =
      Dnc.normalComparison P d X.g aB X.s X.section_eq ≪≫
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
          (P.chartSectionOrientation d (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj X.g X.s) aB
            X.s.normalConeZeroSection t)
